routes.title: Srinidhi Chakravarthy — Product Designer
routes.description: Product designer with a background in psychology and UX research. Master's in UX from Purdue. Case studies from Microsoft, AI research tools, and scientific software.

routes.title: Work — Srinidhi Chakravarthy
routes.description: Case studies across AI systems, cybersecurity, enterprise observability, scientific software, and physical product design.

routes.title: About — Srinidhi Chakravarthy
routes.description: I started in psychology, pivoted to design. Both ask the same question: how could I give someone more agency? Master's in UX from Purdue.

routes.title: Play — Srinidhi Chakravarthy
routes.description: Side projects and experiments: physical computing, VR interiors, parametric fabrication, and generative visuals.

routes.title: Health Observability Monitor — Microsoft Azure

routes.title: AI Coding Interviewer — Purdue CS

routes.title: Psychosis Psychoeducation App — Srinidhi Chakravarthy

routes.title: Malli 2.0 — Toilet Cleaning Device
